high_level_description: The image features a close-up of a woman wearing exquisite jewelry. The focus is on her neck and shoulders, highlighting the intricate details of the jewelry she is wearing. She has long, dark brown hair that cascades over her shoulders. Her makeup is done elegantly, with bright red lipstick adding a pop of color to her look. The jewelry consists of a necklace and matching earrings. The necklace features large, rectangular emerald stones set in a floral pattern, surrounded by smaller diamonds. The earrings are similarly designed, with a central emerald stone flanked by diamond accents.
